name: Quail
overview: Scripture reveals God's provision of quail as a miraculous supply of food for the Israelites during their wilderness journey. In Exodus 16:13 and Numbers 11:31-32, God sent quail to cover the camp, enabling the people to gather abundant meat after their request for sustenance. Psalm 105:40 affirms that God satisfied His people with quail, demonstrating His faithfulness to sustain them with heavenly provision in the wilderness.
